name: UltraBlur
description: Plex-identical UltraBlur ambient corner colors extracted from item artwork, with an auto-injected web client script and a REST API for native clients.
overview: Plex-style ambient gradients for Jellyfin detail pages.

versions.changelog:
- In-process extraction: managed C# port of PMS UltraBlur, byte-identical to the bit-exact C++ port (199/199 dataset, 96/99 vs Plex GT, 39/39 edge cases incl. resize/EXIF/PNG/WebP)
- No ultrablur_cli binary needed; CliPath/TimeoutSeconds settings removed
- Decodes with the host's SkiaSharp (verified identical to Plex's OpenCV on 10.11 and 12)
- Verified unchanged in PMS 1.43.4

- Config page load/save wiring
- Request-time web client script injection (no theme edits)
- Batch colors endpoint for native clients
- Multi-target Jellyfin 10.11 / 12 builds
